chronology: Existing selected valuation and Foundry stresses are already known. This policy precedes the new packaging scale calculation; it is not valuation-blind research.
question: What if one of the two assumed 3B customer families does not materialize?
scale: Retain 4/7 of selected gross new-program revenue in every modeled year. This yields 4B gross in 2030 instead of 7B. Keep the existing shadow revenue/profit allowance inside host Foundry unchanged; all missing sales therefore reduce the net incremental program. The revenue-pattern proportion is a conditional stress, not an inferred customer shipment calendar.

cost_bounds.proportional_cash_cost_avoidance: Avoid the same fraction of modeled incremental cash operating cost as lost incremental sales. Cost is net incremental sales minus net incremental EBIT minus incremental D&A; it includes central cash-equivalent SBC. Retain all D&A. This is the optimistic cash-cost-flexibility endpoint, not an observed elasticity or unchanged EBIT margin.
cost_bounds.no_cash_cost_avoidance: Retain all modeled incremental cash operating cost and D&A. EBIT falls by exactly the lost sales. This is the adverse committed-cost endpoint, not a likely forecast.

capital: Retain every dollar of original packaging physical capex and D&A in 2027–30. After 2030 retain the original packaging D&A and matching maintenance capex, but fund new packaging growth at the existing 1.0 sales/net-capital turnover using the smaller sales path. Recompute WC at 15% of new net incremental sales. No return of sunk capital, tax-credit gain or sale of unused tools is assumed.
host: Keep CPU, client, Other DCAI, legacy Foundry, embedded packaging, host capital, leases, NCI and finite credits unchanged. Host external-revenue denominator is unchanged because gross and net-new packaging revenue decline by the same dollar amount.
accounting: Change net incremental packaging EBIT by lost sales less the explicitly avoidable cash cost. Do not also apply a CPU/client 50% decremental, host Foundry penalty, shadow-profit subtraction, gross-margin penalty or extra absorption charge.
boundary: These endpoints bound two modeled cost-flexibility conventions only; they are not a statistical confidence interval or all possible commercial outcomes. Actual supply contracts, scrap/yield responses, program mix, future capital cancellation and pricing are undisclosed. Gross packaging revenue may include Intel-owned materials but not customer-consigned accelerator/HBM value.
public_volume_fee_status: No primary accepted-good-package quantity, net per-package fee, or minimum annual fee was identified that independently validates the 7B forecast. MediaTek ASIC revenue is not a package-fee proxy.
